senses.gloss: लम्ब- + उदर लम्ब- + उदर, m. 1. a glutton. 2. Gaṇeśa.
लम्ब- + कर्ण लम्ब- + कर्ण, m. 1. a goat. 2. an elephant. 3. a Rākṣasa.

लम्पट लम्पट (vb. लप्, but cf. also लिम्पट),
 I. adj. Covetous, greedy, Pañc. 253, 18.
 II. m. A libertine, Lass. 83, 18 (Prākṛ.).
लम्पटत्व लम्पट + त्व, n. Greediness, Bhartṛ. 3, 67.

लम्पाक लम्पाक, m.
 1. A libertine (see the last).
 2. The name of a country.

लम्ब् लम्ब्, i. 1, Ātm. (Par., Pañc. 107, 25).
 1. To fall, MBh. 2, 2187.
 2. To set (as the sun), Rām. 1, 33, 20.
 3. To hang downwards, Pañc. v. d. 36.
 4. † To sound.
 --Ptcple. of the pres. लम्बमान.
 1. Depending, Pañc. 259, 7.
 2. Being large or bulky, Pañc. 136, 1.
 --With the prep. अव अव,
 1. To fall, MBh. 1, 1035; to descend, Hit. 25, 5, M.M.
 2. To set, MBh. 4, 1040.
 3. To rest upon, Lass. 5, 11.
 4. To lean on, to be supported, MBh. 1, 8443.
 5. To suspend, Pañc. 252, 10.
 6. To support, to hold, Śāk. 86, 21; Vikr. 49, 16.
 7. To take, Śāk. 108, 19. With धैर्यम्,
 a. To take courage, Hit. 13, 19.
 b. To keep firm, i. e. to yield not, Vikr. 34, 4.
 8. To choose, Śāk. 70, 14. अवलम्बित,
 1. Hanging, Pañc. 116, 23.
 2. Hanging with the head downwards, Lass. 15, 18.
 3. Supported, Vikr. 7, 5.
 4. Depended upon, Hit. i. d. 143, M.M.
 --Caus. To support, Mālav. 31, 2; to hold, 42, 6.
 --With समव सम्-अव, To support, MBh. 3, 10988.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To lean on, to depend upon, Chr. 28, 16.
 2. To support, MBh. 3, 10989.
 3. To keep (स्थैर्यं गृहे, To stay at home), Pañc. 225, 23.
 4. To take, Ghaṭ. 22; to seize, Rājat. 5, 432. With धैर्यम्, To take courage, Pañc. 21, 8. With धृतिम्, To be untroubled, Kathās. 22, 100. आलम्बित,
 1. Hanging, Vikr. d. 140.
 2. [] Laid on, Vikr. d. 125. नालम्बित, i. e. न-आलम्बित, Unsupported, hopeless, Vikr. d. 38.
 --With समा सम्-आ,
 1. To suspend, Pañc. 144, 23.
 2. To maintain, Hit. i. d. 193, M.M.
 3. To take, Mṛcch. 55, 19.
 4. To dwell, Hit. i. d. 211, M.M.
 --With उद् उद्, उल्लम्बित, Hanging (between heaven and earth), Mṛcch. 33, 19.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्, समुल्लम्बित, Hanging, 34, 2.
 --With प्र प्र, प्रलम्बित, Hanging.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To suspend, Pañc. 98, 4.
 --With वि वि, To tarry, Śāk. 18, 21; Pañc. 84, 10. अ-विलम्बित, adj. Without delay, Mālav. 53, 13; Vikr. 79, 13.
 --Caus.
 1. To suspend, Pañc. 116, 19.
 2. To delay, iii. d. 232.
 --With प्रवि प्र-वि, Pañc. 98, 4; erroneous reading, see my transl. n. 480.
 --Cf. Lat. labi; A.S. limpian, ge-limp; Engl. To limp.

लम्ब लम्ब् + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Depending, Megh. 82. 88.
 2. Long, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1210; Śāk. 87, 15 (Prākṛ.).
 3. Expanded, large, Hiḍ. 2, 3.
 4. Spacious.
 II. m.
 1. A bribe.
 2. Moving a man at a sort of backgammon.
 III. f. बा.
 1. Lakṣmī.
 2. Durgā.
 3. A bitter gourd.
 --Comp.
लम्बक लम्ब + क, m. A section, Kathās. 1, 8.

लम्बन लम्ब् + अन, n.
 1. Falling.
 2. A long necklace reaching to the navel.
लम्बय लम्बय, a denomin. derived from लम्ब, Par. To extend, Ragh. 6, 75 (Calc.).
लम्बालकत्व लम्बालकत्व, i. e. लम्ब-अलक + त्व, n. Hanging down of the curls, Megh. 82.

लम्बिन् लम्ब् + इन्, adj. Depending, [] Pañc. i. d. 160.
 --Comp.
लम्बुषा लम्ब् + उषा, f. A necklace of seven strings.
लम्भ् लम्भ्, see रम्भ् and लभ्.
लम्भ लम्भ, i. e. लभ् + अ, m. Gain, Vikr. 49, 16.

लम्भन लम्भन, i. e. लभ् + अन, n.
 1. Gaining, getting.
 2. Causing to get, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 12.
 3. Abuse, reviling.
लम्ब- + स्फिच् लम्ब- + स्फिच्, adj. having large buttocks, Hiḍ. 2, 3.
